dedupe_keys.name: smarteole wind farm control open dataset

description: Thomas Duc and Eric Simley publish the final SMARTEOLE field campaign at the seven-turbine Sole du Moulin Vieux wind farm in France. Temporal coverage runs from 17 February to 25 May 2020. Wake-steering tests applied yaw offsets to one turbine. The released collection contains one-minute SCADA measurements, control logs, ground-based lidar observations, coordinates, correction functions and turbine power or thrust curves. Zenodo serves a ZIP archive containing CSV tables and an Excel variable guide, free under the Etalab 2.0 licence recorded in its metadata. Periods when any turbine stopped were removed, and direction signals were corrected for alignment. Nacelle-lidar measurements are excluded; derived transfer functions are supplied instead. The data support validation of wake-steering and wind-farm control simulations but do not represent unfiltered operating availability. No related existing catalogue record is explicitly identified by the deposit.
